data.name: Camella
data.gender_notes: Camella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient Greece, Camella was derived from the word ‘kamelos’, meaning ‘young plant’ or ‘camellia flower’. The name represents the beauty, grace, and tenderness of the camellia blossom. In Christianity, Camella can be seen as a symbol of faith and devotion. The name Camella carries the meaning “Gentle, beautiful camellia flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Camella usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful camellia flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Camella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, beautiful camellia flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Camella total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קאמילה
in_hebrew.meaning: קאמילה היא שם שפירושו ניקיון וטוהר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאמילה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הלטינית, אך הוא משמש גם בתרבות היהודית. פירוש השם הוא ניקיון וטוהר, והוא קשור למושגים של טהרה וקדושה. השם קאמילה מופיע בתרבויות שונות, והוא משמש כסמל לטוהר ולניקיון.

in_greek.name: Καμέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καμέλα προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα και σημαίνει καθαρότητα και αγνότητα. Στην ελληνική κουλτούρα, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της καθαρότητας και της αγνότητας, και συχνά δίνεται σε κορίτσια που γεννιούνται σε οικογένειες με ισχυρή χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Camella
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Camella originates from the Latin language and means purity and cleanliness. In the early Christian church, the name Camella was associated with the concept of spiritual purity and was often given to girls born into families with strong Christian traditions.

in_english.name: Camella
in_english.long_meaning: The name Camella is derived from the Latin words 'camellus' or 'camilla', which mean 'young ceremonial attendant' or 'pure'. In Christian tradition, Camella symbolizes purity, innocence, and cleanliness. Historically, the name has been associated with virtues of modesty and humility. Today, Camella remains a popular name across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a strong connection to faith and spiritual values.

data.spiritual_significance: Camella, as a Christian name, can be seen as a symbol of faith and devotion. The camellia flower, with its beautiful, yet delicate and sometimes fragile blossoms, represents the spiritual life of a Christian. Just as the flower requires care and attention to bloom, so too does the Christian life require constant nurturing through prayer, meditation, and the study of scripture. The name Camella can serve as a reminder to keep our faith alive and appreciate the beauty and grace that exists in our spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Camella, in Christian symbolism, represents the sweetness and beauty of the love of Christ. Her name, derived from the Latin word for camellia flower, signifies the fragrant and delightful nature of His divine grace. With Camella as a name, one is reminded to cherish and spread the sweetness of faith in their daily lives.
